title: A provider that rejects the credentials ends the run with auth_error, not a fabricated turn
description: The harness replaces the model provider's credential variables with a well-formed but invalid key, so the first inference fails authentication. The agent MUST report error_occurred(auth_error) and close with agent_stopped(error), and MUST NOT present the failure as model output: no assistant_message may appear. This is the provider-failure path integration tests cover per adapter, asserted cross-agent on a real provider.

forbidden_events.label: assistant_message (a failed inference is not a turn)
